newsitem.title: USA: TEXFI WARNS LOWER THAN EXPECTED Q3 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: TEXFI WARNS LOWER THAN EXPECTED Q3 EARNINGS.

text.p: Texfi Industries Inc warned investors Thursday by saying it expects to report a loss of $0.09 to $0.10 a share in its fiscal third quarter and anticipates its fourth quarter earnings will be below current analyst estimates.
The company did say that it expects break-even results for the second half of its fiscal 1997, as a result of sales of higher priced specialty products in the its fiscal fourth quarter.
Dane Vincent, Texfi's chief financial officer predicted the company would "achieve earnings of $1.5 million for fiscal 1997 following three years of restructuring and operating losses.
The company also announced that it is selling its Narrow Fabrics operations, based in Asheboro, N.C. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Included in the sale will be all of the assets and liabilities of the knitted elastic fabric division. The company said it expects to close the deal on Sept 15, and use the proceeds to reduce bank debt and provide additional working capital.
